name: Western Kentucky University
tuition_note: 2026-27 in-state (Kentucky resident) full-time undergraduate tuition & fees ($6,138/semester x 2 = $12,276/year) from wku.edu/billing/coa.php. Housing is room only from wku.edu/housing/halls/rates.php: standard double-occupancy rate $3,200/semester x 2 = $6,400/year for traditional halls (Gilbert, McCormack, Minton, PFT, Rodes Harlin); rates range up to $9,280/year for premium halls.
